test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: X boys can do a work in 80 days. In how much time, 2X boys will do half of the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

X boys can do a work in 80 days

**Concept used:**

(M₁ × H₁ × D₁)/ W₁ = (M2 × H2 × D2)/ W2

**Calculation:**

⇒ (M1 × D1)/ W1 = (M2 × D2)/ W2

⇒ (X × 80)/1 = (2X × D2)/0.5

⇒ D2 = 20 days

**∴ The correct answer is 20 days.**
